After traveling, he returned to Brazil and began writing lyrics with established musician Raul Seixas around 1972. Their partnership produced a landmark Brazilian rock album in 1973, when Coelho was 25. He was briefly imprisoned and tortured in 1974 for subversive activities.
family_context_summary: Born into a middle-class family in Rio de Janeiro; father Pedro was an engineer, mother Lygia a housewife. Parents committed him to a mental institution at 17 due to his rebellious behavior, from which he escaped three times.
